# Visual Patterns

## Overview

This resource provides optional decorative SVG assets for slide backgrounds, section dividers, and hero accents. These are design choices — not brand compliance requirements — and are not audited by brand compliance tools.

## How to Use

These visual patterns are reference assets for presentation design. When creating slides, you can incorporate these patterns as decorative elements.

**To add a pattern to a slide**, reference the appropriate SVG file based on your background color:
> Use **Teal variants** on light/white backgrounds
> Use **White variants** on dark/black/teal-hero backgrounds

**To select an accent pattern**, browse the pattern catalog below and choose based on the visual style needed for your presentation.

**Files in this resource:**
- Pattern SVGs (Arrows, Z Pattern, Slash Pattern, etc.)
- Form SVGs (Rise, Globe, Circle Web, Ripple, etc.)
- This README for usage guidance

---

## Color Variant Guidance

| Variant | Use on |
|---------|--------|
| **Teal** | Light / white backgrounds |
| **White** | Dark / black / teal-hero backgrounds |
| **Electric Teal** | Dark backgrounds (Arrows only) |
| **Electric Green** | Dark backgrounds (Arrows only) |
| **Electric Fuchsia** | Dark backgrounds (Arrows only) |
| **Black** | Light backgrounds when a bolder look is needed (Arrows only) |

## Usage in Slides

Patterns and forms can be applied as positioned background overlays on a slide. For example, placing a pattern as a subtle accent in the bottom-right corner:

```html
<div class="slide dark" data-slide="3" style="position:relative;">
  <!-- Pattern overlay -->
  <img src="visual-patterns/BAH_Pattern_Arrows_ElectricTeal_RGB.svg"
       alt="" role="presentation"
       style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;width:360px;opacity:0.12;pointer-events:none;">
  <!-- Slide content -->
  <h2>Headline Here</h2>
  <p>Content goes here.</p>
  <div class="slide-footer">...</div>
</div>
```

Since generated HTML files must be self-contained, patterns should be base64-encoded as data URIs at generation time rather than referenced as external files.
